Just below the Canadian border in Maine is a part of America far removed from the rest of the country. It’s a wild and remote region locals call “The County,” with deep Acadian roots—the origin story of Louisiana’s Cajuns—and a culture all its own. Join me for a solo road trip through the most remote part of the East Coast, meeting old-school locals and exploring this mysterious corner of America. This is the final video in the Maine series, and definitely my favorite.
